action_items.item: JRN-40: someone has to check a real inbox and how the email looks. Statuses stay ACCEPTED because there is no delivery webhook (known spec deviation).

Reply-To on the salon contact notice was checked only in code (lib/email/notices.ts:107 replyTo: msg.email, sent to the provider as contact_email). The delivery row does not store Reply-To, so the API cannot confirm it.

checks.name: test_tscheck_p2_reschedule_cancel_reminders.py
checks.evidence: This test's own reminder jobs were forced due and the worker was run twice before and after sending. 24H and 2H were each ACCEPTED exactly once. Reschedule via manage link (200) gave APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULED ACCEPTED. Cancel (200) gave APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED: first rate_limited, then requeued and ACCEPTED.

checks.name: notice-email-empty-dashboard-warning
checks.evidence: Notice email cleared and saved (contactEmail was already empty). dashboard-missing-notice-email-warning is visible. salonSettings noticeEmail/contactEmail are back to null, the original state.

checks.evidence: Booking returned 200 with 1 APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMATION and 0 SALON_NOTICE_BOOKING for that appointment.

checks.name: test_tscheck_p2_booking_welcome_notice.py+scheduler lease observation
checks.evidence: The panel APPOINTMENT_CONFIRMATION job was rate-limited at 19:47 and completed at 20:00:43.257, the exact lastRunAt of the in-app scheduler lease 'job-queue'. The lease runs every ~5 min (19:45:43, 19:55:43, 20:00:43).

notes: The managed sender's rate limit was hit several times. Each time the delivery was FAILED with [rate_limited], then requeued and later ACCEPTED, as designed.
JRN-37 (campaigns) is out of scope by spec. The existing FAILED campaign rows show the explicit reason 'solo admite correo transaccional'.
